name: MMC5983MA 3-axis magnetometer

procurement.note: User pick 2026-09-12, magnetometer half of the MPU-9250 replacement pair (with icm42688p). OPN registration in flight via PLM.

orientation.die_frame: axes per datasheet; alignment error +/-1 deg typ (+/-3 max) - note for estimator calibration
orientation.mount_note: Keep away from motor/ESC current loops; mag placement is an interference decision, CAD/EE coordinate

ee.footprint_note: LGA-16 3.0x3.0x1.0mm - EE to create/select during SB2 re-spin

design_notes: Integrated SET/RESET (degauss) clears residual magnetization and null-field offset temp drift - driver should use it periodically or on temp change
Supply is 3.0V nominal (abs max 3.6V) - NOT 5V tolerant; share the clean IMU rail with care

mag.provenance: MEMSIC MMC5983MA datasheet Rev A (memsic.com); no sim consumer yet - reserved
